subject: english
question:
Choose the correct meaning of the idiom:
'To go through fire and water'
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. **Face any difficulty**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The idiom **"To go through fire and water"** means to face any difficulty or endure extreme hardships for a purpose. (किसी मुश्किल का सामना करना)
 
 
• **Example:** He was willing to go through fire and water to achieve his dreams.
 
 
• This idiom signifies courage and determination in the face of challenges. (मुश्किल परिस्थितियों में साहस और दृढ़ता)
